title: docs(adr): ADR-0093 D3 amendment note, bulk import joins the administrator's current organization
body:
Fixes #34809

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

> **Governed / Tier H.** The diff touches `docs/adr/**` only, a Tier H row of `GOVERNED_SURFACES`. The note sits under the record's `Decisions` heading, the status line gains an entry, and the behaviour it describes is the admin user import (auth). So the low-risk add-only arm does not apply: it lands by the maintainer's hand or an authorized approval, and this area never readies, queues or arms it.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：ADR-0093 的 D3 修订（2026-10-24）末段下面，加一条带日期（2026-11-17）的修订说明；状态行末尾加一条 Amended。原裁决句一字未动。说明记录的是：有墙（多组织）模式下，批量导入的每一行用户都加入管理员当前所在的组织。
- 为什么改：你在 #34535 裁了 B（裁决记录 6942842013），PR #34750（合并提交 `36af6b05a7`）已经落地。ADR 那一句还写着批量导入在多组织下不绑定任何组织，和代码相左。
- 风险与回滚：纯文档，没有代码，不发布任何东西；回滚即 revert 本 PR。另有一处要知道：在开的 PR #34909 也在同一条状态行末尾追加了一句，两边在这一行上有文本冲突；后落地的一方合 main 时把两句都留下即可。
- 先看：`docs/adr/0093-tenancy-mode-and-membership-lifecycle.md` 第 276–307 行的修订说明。风险点是 upsert 那一条：它写明「已属于其他组织的已有用户，被 CSV 匹配到时也会加入管理员当前组织」。再看第 3 行状态行末尾新增的一句。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs && node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs && node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check`，预期三条都以 0 退出，最后一条印 `adr-index: OK`。
- 需要你做的：按 Tier H 审读并批准本 PR。

## What changes

One file, `docs/adr/0093-tenancy-mode-and-membership-lifecycle.md`, +34 / −1:

- **An add-only dated note under the D3 amendment (2026-10-24)**, in the record's own `Amendment note (date, ruling)` blockquote form (the form of its 2026-11-11 note under D8). It says the amendment's closing sentence no longer holds for bulk import, and records what PR #34750 landed for `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users`. It cites maintainer ruling 6942842013 (option B) and merge commit `36af6b05a7`.
- **The ruled 2026-10-24 sentence is not rewritten.** The note states that the sentence stands as ruled for the reconciler and for the other creation paths it names (self sign-up, SSO JIT, host hooks).
- **The status line gains one `Amended` entry** dated 2026-11-17, as the two later amendments of this record did (2026-11-08 and 2026-11-11). This is the one modified line of the diff: the entry is appended to the single status line.
- `docs/adr/README.md` is unchanged. `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check` answers that it is current (the index shows only the head of a status line).

## Tests

None: the diff is one ADR. Nothing published moves, so no changeset (`skip-changeset`).

## Acceptance notes

**The landed facts, FROM → TO, each read at `origin/main` `4443014630`.** "Walled posture" is `tenancy.isolationActive === true`, the predicate `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-user-endpoints.ts#multiOrgCreationJoinsCurrentOrganization` reads.

| Fact in the note | Before `36af6b05a7` | At `main` | Where it is read | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Settled before any row is written, on a dry run too | no settlement | `settleCurrentOrganizationJoin` runs before `runImport`, with no `dryRun` branch before it | `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts#runAdminImportUsers` | the two `no current organization` cases (`dryRun` false and true) |
| No current organization | `200`, rows created in no organization | `400 NO_ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION`, Create User's sentence, nothing created | `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-user-endpoints.ts#settleCurrentOrganizationJoin` | same cases, asserted equal to the settlement's own answer; dogfood I2 |
| No unit of work wired, or no `addMember` on better-auth's API | `200`, rows created | `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, nothing created | same function (`!seam` or `addMember` not a function) | `a host with no unit of work, or no organization plugin` |
| Created row: account and join are one unit of work | account only, no membership | `createUser` and `joinCurrentOrganization` inside `join.seam.runAtomically` | `inRowUnit` in `runAdminImportUsers`; `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-user-endpoints.ts#joinCurrentOrganization` | `every created row joins`; dogfood I1 |
| A refused join | n/a | row `failed` with the vendor's code, account rolled back, no temporary password, no invitation, other rows land | `inRowUnit` rethrows `CreationRefused` as the row's error; the password and the invitation target are recorded after the unit returns | `a row whose join is refused`, `a refused row under the temporary policy`; dogfood I1 |
| Upsert-matched existing user | profile updated, no membership | joined in the same unit as its profile update; a refused join fails the row and leaves the profile; an existing member is not added twice | `updateData` in `runAdminImportUsers` calls `inRowUnit('existing', …)` | the two `upsert:` cases |
| A dry run that is not refused | joins nothing | joins nothing | `runImport` with `dryRun` writes no row | `a dry run with a current organization joins nothing` |
| Single mode, a degraded wall included | no join | no join; no session read, no transaction | `multiOrgCreationJoinsCurrentOrganization` answers false | `CONTROL single-org (or a degraded wall)` |

The unit pins are the multi-org describe of `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users-manager-pass.test.ts`; the dogfood pins are I1 and I2 of `packages/qa/dogfood/test/create-user-organization-join.dogfood.test.ts`.

**Where the note differs from the card's drafted paragraph, and why:**

- The draft edited the ruled sentence (it took `bulk import` out of the list). The claim's form is add-only, so the sentence is untouched and the note says where it no longer holds.
- `no organization plugin` is written as the code tests it: no `addMember` on better-auth's API. `no unit of work` is the host wiring no seam for the creation.
- `multi mode` is written `under a walled posture`, the amendment's own words for the predicate, because a degraded wall is multi-requested and does not join.
- Added from the merged PR's table and the code: a refused row gets no temporary password and no invitation and the other rows go on; a dry run that is not refused joins nothing; an existing member is not added twice.
- Added, and worth the approver's eye: the upsert bullet says the matched user joins `whichever other organizations that user already belongs to`. This is read from the code, not from a pin: the membership probe in `joinCurrentOrganization` asks only about the current organization, and the import matches users across the deployment. The contract review of PR #34750 (6946273468) raised the same consequence for the approver.
- Added: the unit of work is named as the engine transaction with the limit ADR-0119 D1 declares (a default driver without `beginTransaction` runs the callback with no rollback). The seam's own comment in `auth-plugin.ts` states that limit, and the same contract review lists it as inherited from Create User.
- `501` on a dry run is true by the code path (the settlement precedes `runImport` whatever `dryRun` says); the pin covers `400` on a dry run and `501` on a real run.

**Nothing moved in review after PR #34750's table was written.** The PR has no review comment and no submitted review; its last two commits type a test harness and repair one docs anchor. `git log 36af6b05a7..4443014630` over the four files above, `auth-plugin.ts` and `reconcile-membership.ts` answers 0 commits, and `git merge-base --is-ancestor 36af6b05a7 4443014630` answers exit 0.

**Notes for the seat, not acted on here:**

- Ruling record 6942842013 says the sentence `is rewritten by the implementing PR`. The claim chose the add-only note instead. This PR follows the claim; the difference from the ruling's letter is the approver's to accept.
- The ruled sentence says SSO JIT and host hooks bind nothing in multi mode, while D3's table and D7 say those flows own membership there. The note repeats the sentence as ruled and does not reword it. Observation only; no card.
- **Overlap.** `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD` answers exit 1: this branch merges cleanly with `origin/main` (`6d2db1d7ef`) and conflicts with open PR #34909 in this file. The conflict is the status line alone (each side appends one `Amended` entry to the same line); the D1 and D7 hunks of that PR and the D3 hunk here merge cleanly. Whichever lands second merges `main` and keeps both entries. The claim recorded no open PR on this file; that reading was wrong at claim time.
